''See also: [[Kyri Prest Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Kyri Prest is a legendary [[Visiri]] figure known for her extensive career in the arena, spanning over twenty-three seasons. A highly accomplished combat artist and powerful [[water elementalist]], she holds the prestigious title of [[Archmage]], an honor she originally earned through her service on the battlefield for [[Visiria]] within the [[Karoshan Alliance]]. Physically, she is characterized by red skin, a third eye, and possesses both an artificial arm and a mechanical hand. Beyond her reputation as a famous duelist and [[wizard]], she has demonstrated the ability to pilot a [[Divine Titan]] mech. Kyri also serves as a combat instructor for the Knights, providing mentorship in both martial skills and [[water]] magic.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Kyri Prest is a red-skinned [[Visiri]] with three eyes, including a third eye that emits a white shine. She possesses sleek, high-grade silver prosthetic arms featuring blue lights, one of which is an [[Aethertech]] replacement. Her [[aura]] appears as a pale pink color close to white.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Kyri serves as a mentor, teacher, and coach, having instructed the narrator in [[water]] magic. She is an experienced combat trainer for the Knights and previously taught within the [[Titan Force]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Kyri Prest serves as a mentor and teacher to the narrator, specifically instructing them in the use of [[water]] magic.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a skilled [[Combat Artist]], Kyri is a famous duelist and [[wizard]] who earned her [[Archmage]] title on the battlefield. She utilizes [[water]] magic and wields a [[wand]] shaped like a jagged silver spike resembling a [[steel]] icicle.}}
